commands._top:
Usage: zensical [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Zensical - A modern static site generator.

Options:
  --version  Show the version and exit.
  --help     Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  build  Build a project.
  new    Create a new template project in the current or given directory.
  serve  Build and serve a project.
commands.build:
Usage: zensical build [OPTIONS]

  Build a project.

Options:
  -f, --config-file PATH  Path to config file.
  -c, --clean             Clean cache.
  -s, --strict            Enable strict mode - abort the build on warnings.
  --help                  Show this message and exit.
commands.serve:
Usage: zensical serve [OPTIONS]

  Build and serve a project.

Options:
  -f, --config-file PATH    Path to config file.
  -a, --dev-addr <IP:PORT>  IP address and port (default: localhost:8000).
  -o, --open                Open preview in default browser.
  -s, --strict              Strict mode (currently unsupported).
  --help                    Show this message and exit.
